patch_list: Removes sharing identifiers and marketing parameters from open.spotify.com links. Keeps playback timestamps, context, and other parameters.
Hides image and video brand-ad sections on Home and Browse. Does not suppress audio ads, player ads, or upgrade prompts. Experimental.
Hides image brand-ad cards and embedded ad pages in Now Playing. Does not suppress audio ads or other player overlays. Experimental.
Hides the Premium navigation tab. Change this in Spicetify settings, then restart Spotify. Does not change your subscription or remove other ads.

Streams audio from an HTTPS WebDAV folder or Jellyfin music library into Local Files and Your Library. Configure the server in Spicetify settings; playback needs Spotify's Local audio files setting. Experimental; requires byte-range suppor…
Pick playlists, albums or Liked Songs to pin first on Home, or turn on Show only my pins to hide Spotify's other shortcuts. Pins are saved on this device; restart Spotify after changing them.

Adds Android versions of Spicetify extensions to the Spicetify Marketplace's Extensions tab, in Spicetify settings, each off until you turn it on. Trash Bin skips the songs and artists you throw away from their menus. Play a random song pl…
Choose a theme, such as OLED, or your own colors in Spicetify settings. Requires Android 11 or later. Some screens and hardcoded colors keep Spotify's colors.

patch_list: Blocks fullscreen promotions ("Pendragon" messages) shown when opening the app.
Allows the Spotify widgets to be added to third party launchers.
Removes brand ad sections from the home and search page.
Hides ad banners, display ads and the ad player.
Removes "Premium" entries from the context menus of songs, albums and playlists.
Removes the "Premium" tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Disables the video ad plugin of the now playing view.
Mutes the music stream while an audio ad plays and restores the volume afterwards. Enabling "Device broadcast status" in the Spotify settings improves the ad detection.
Removes the tracking parameters (si, utm_source) from shared and copied links.
